note: P varies in angle and moment (post-storm wave sky held in hands, dusk pearl draining, a palm shading the sun with edge iridescence, cold hands catching colour), though P2 and P4 share the pearl-draining-colour idea. Q is essentially one poem four times: nacreous/mother-of-pearl light on cold air at dusk or dawn, with the sky holding its breath, all in near-identical wording.
